ModMetaData.name: Ocular Jelly Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Alpha Animals's AA_OcularJelly art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Cauldron sheet 2026-10-04, owner pick B). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_OcularJelly/AA_OcularJelly_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
